{{Top}} {{Otheruses|Pax}} {{Character |type=Criminal |image=[[File:Pax-SkeletonCrew.png]] |name=Pax |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Gran]]{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{AD|Disney+}} |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Black]] |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Silvo's pirates]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|[Pax growls in Huttese]
"''We're not trying to escape. We just want to hear.''"
[Pax speaks Huttese]|quotestart=0|quoteend=0|italics=0|Pax stops Fern entering the cockpit of the ''Onyx Cinder''|{{SkeletonCrew|We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble}}}} '''Pax''' was a [[Gran]] [[pirate]] who was a member of [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]]'s [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] during the [[New Republic Era|era]] of the [[New Republic]]. He took part in the boarding of a [[Unidentified bulk freighter (New Republic Era)|merchant freighter]] and helped overwhelm its crew, but once the [[freighter]] was revealed to be carrying only a single [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] in its vault, Pax and the others mutinied against Silvo. With [[Brutus]] as their new captain, the pirates then traveled to [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]], where Pax helped Brutus capture a group of [[Youngling|children]]. After Silvo escaped and was recaptured, Pax attended his trial aboard Brutus's [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]] and nodded when the former captain was sentenced to [[death]]. However, when Silvo promised the pirates riches if they followed him to an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[At Attin Mint|mint]] on the [[planet]] [[At Attin]], Pax beat a fist against his chest as Silvo sang a shanty. The pirates then traveled to At Attin and found it surrounded by a [[Barrier]] that they could not pass. After they captured the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'', a ship that could pass through the Barrier, Silvo killed Brutus while the pirates boarded the vessel. Back in command, Silvo ordered Pax and the pirate [[Kona]] to capture the group of children on board the ''Onyx Cinder'', which the pair did. After watching a [[Hologram|holographic]] message from the childrens' [[parent]]s on the ship, Pax, Kona, and Silvo were knocked out by the [[droid]] [[SM-33]] after the child [[Fern]] reclaimed ownership of the vessel. ==Biography== ===Mutiny=== {{Quote|See that they don't run off again.|Brutus orders Pax and the other pirates to capture the children|}} [[File:PaxMutiny-SC1.png|thumb|right|300px|Pax and his comrades mutinied against Silvo after an unsuccessful raid on a merchant freighter.]] Pax was a [[Gran]] [[pirate]] that served in the [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] of [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] aboard a [[Silvo's pirate frigate|pirate frigate]] during the [[New Republic Era|era]] of the [[New Republic]]. After a few lean cycles in which some of the crew started to doubt Silvo, the [[frigate]] attacked a [[Unidentified bulk freighter (New Republic Era)|merchant freighter]] and puncutred its sides with drill-tipped boarding tubes. Pax and many other pirates rushed down the tubes onto the [[freighter]], with the first of them through gunned down by the merchant crew. Pax was among the next wave, which made it on board safely, opening fire on the merchants and quickly overwhelming them. With the remaining merchants taken [[prisoner]], Pax and the other pirates made their way to the freighter's magnetically sealed vault, where Silvo tried to force the [[Unidentified merchant captain|merchant captain]] to open it. The captain refused, and Silvo ordered that he be thrown out the [[airlock]] before ordering a pirate to open the vault with an [[arc welder]]. As Pax and the other assembled pirates waited, Silvo spoke to them of the lean cycles and promised [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] within the vault; however, once it was opened the vault was revealed to contain only a single credit. As the pirate [[Brutus]] berated the captain for the lives lost over a single credit, other pirates drew their weapons on Silvo in mutiny. Pax did not draw his, but instead patted Silvo on the shoulder while gnashing his [[goat]]-like [[Tooth|teeth]]. Silvo then punched the Gran in the head before swinging at other pirates. [[File:BrutusCrew-SC2.png|thumb|left|300px|Pax served under Brutus on Port Borgo after the mutiny against Silvo.]] With Brutus as their new captain, the pirates took the [[frigate]] to the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]]. After a group of [[Youngling|children]] from the mythical [[planet]] [[At Attin]] arrived in the port, they got into an altercation with Pax's crewmate [[Vane]] and several other pirates over the Old Republic credits they were carrying. Hearing about the commotion, Brutus made his way to the children's location with Pax and other members of the crew, gunning down the childrens' [[droid]] [[SM-33]]. Brutus then left Pax and the others to throw the children in the port's [[Prison|brig]].{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} ===Trial=== {{Quote|Tak Rennod soared away, away aboard the Onyx Cinder and never was he seen again… ''What's the last line?''"
"''For At Attin, he did plunder.''"
"For At Attin, he did plunder.|italics=0|Silvo sings to Koma and the other pirates as Pax beats a fist against his chest|}} The children soon escaped from the brig with Silvo, who had also been imprisoned there.{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} The pirates eventually re-captured Silvo on{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}} the [[planet]]{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} [[Lanupa]] and he was brought to Brutus' [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]] for trial. Pax was among those who gathered to watch and nodded while others cheered when Brutus found the former captain guilty and sentenced him to [[death]]. The pirate [[Chaelt]] then interupted and reminded Brutus of Silvo's [[Right of Last Appeal]] under the [[Pirate's Code]], and so Silvo was given equal [[time]] to defend himself. Pax listened as Silvo reminded them all how hungry they were for wealth, having survived only on the scraps [[the galaxy]] had offered. The former captain then suggested he had a way for them to generate their own endless wealth, revealing an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] that the Gran leant forward to see. Silvo then informed the pirates that he had learned of the location of a mint that could make the credits from the legendary pirate [[Tak Rennod]] and began singing a chant about about Rennod's journey to At Attin. Pax beat one [[Limb|fist]] against his chest as Silvo sang with other pirates joining in and then cheering when Silvo revealed the mint was on At Attin. With the equal time run out, Brutus declared that they would travel to At Attin to search for the mint, but that Silvo would still be executed if they were disappointed. ===Further changes in leadership=== {{Quote|Kona, Pax. Seize the vessel. You'll find four scared children on board. Hold them hostage.|Silvo|}} When they arrived at At Attin, the pirates found it surrounded by a [[Barrier]] that destroyed the [[snub-fighter]] of the pirate [[Glerb]] when he was sent in as a volunteer. The ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'', a starship that Silvo knew could safely pass through the Barrier, then arrived alongside the [[frigate]] and was captured, with the pirates dragging into the frigate's [[hangar]] with a [[tractor beam]]. Pax was then part of a group who accompanied Brutus and Silvo to board the ''Onyx Cinder'', waiting at the base of its boarding ramp with weapons drawn as Brutus ascended first. The captain was then grabbed by a cargo arm from within the ship, which help him helpless in midair as a voice from within the ship demanded that the pirates let them leave if they wanted to avoid Brutus coming to harm. Silvo took Brutus's [[blaster musket]] and shot the mutineer, turning to Pax and the other shocked pirates and asking if anyone still wanted to follow the Shistavanen. Lowering their weapons, Pax and the others accepted Silvo's return to leadership, and the restored captain ordered the Gran and the pirate [[Kona]] to board the ''Onyx Cinder'' and capture the four children they would find within, the same children the pirates had previously capture on Port Borgo. ===You call that a knife? This is a knife=== Pax and Kona successfuly took the children hostage and confined them to one of the ''Onyx Cinder's'' tables as Silvo and the [[droid]] [[SM-33]] searched in the vessel's [[cockpit]] for the technology that allowed the ''Onyx Cinder'' to pass through the Barrier. Noticing an incoming transmission, Silvo played it and discovered it was a [[Hologram|holographic]] message from the childrens' [[parent]]s on At Attin. Kona left Pax to guard the children and entered the cockpit to watch, but when the children tried to follow, Pax held them back with a large [[knife]], growling at them in [[Huttese]]. The Gran then moved through to the cockpit to watch the hologram as well, leaving the children to plot how they might regain control of the ship. As the message ended, the child [[Wim]] charged into the cockpit to try and attack Silvo, but Pax quickly grabbed him; however, the other children the attack Pax, allowing Wim to struggle free and continue his charge. Kona then grabbed Wim and Pax used his knife to push back the other children, with the child [[Neel]] quickly apologizing to the armed Gran. Silvo ordered Kona to chain up Wim, but when the child claimed that the ''Onyx Cinder'' belonged to him and the other children rather then Silvo, SM-33 pointed out that the ship was currently unclaimed, since Silvo had become captain of the pirate frigate instead. Wim attempted to claim the ship, but Silvo covered the child's mouth and reclaimed it for himself. SM-33 accepted this, but the child [[Fern]] then pushed past Pax and called "unclaimsies" before claiming the ship, which SM-33 decided was "close enough" and knocked out Silvo. Pax and Kona then opened fire on the droid, but he deflected their bolts with wrist shields and knocked the pair out, dumping all three unconcious pirates on the hangar floor of the frigate. Silvo then woke quickly enough to re-board the ''Onyx Cinder'' before it took off and entered the Barrier. ==Personality and traits== Pax had [[Color|tan]] skin and black [[eye]]s, although his right-most eye stalk was missing. ==Equipment== Pax wore a green [[Clothing|tunic]] with tan pants, black [[boot]]s, black gloves, a brown [[belt]], and a black [[eye patch]]. He used a [[blaster pistol]] and knife in combat. ==Behind the scenes== Pax was portrayed by performance artist [[Mike Estes]] in the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', first appearing simultaneously in the first two episodes—"[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]" and "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]"—when they aired on [[December 2]],
